Hi Monica, Ethan —

Thanks — we’ve received the request and the signed offer. Quick note on timeline and next steps:
- We can begin the standard background screen today once we have Ethan’s signed consent (I see a blank consent placeholder in the folder).
- For identity verification we do a short remote ID check (video + ID photo). Please have Ethan pick a 15-minute slot here: https://checkmate.com/schedule/ABC123.
- Employment verifications can take 24–72 hours depending on the previous employer’s responsiveness; we’ll ping Anna Morales and follow up proactively.

Ethan — please attach a completed background_consent_form.pdf and confirm your preferred times. If you’d rather we call, let us know best number and times.

Estimated turnaround: basic criminal + SSN trace within 2–3 business days after consent; employment verification may extend the final report by 1–3 days.

Regards,
Jules Carter
